claims: Justin Bieber is headlining the Coachella Stage on Saturday, April 11, 2026 (Weekend 1) at 11:25 p.m. PDT.
Justin Bieber is scheduled to perform again on Saturday, April 18, 2026 (Weekend 2).
Justin Bieber's set follows The Strokes (9 p.m.).
Justin Bieber's set can be streamed on the official Coachella YouTube channel.
The stage is the Main "Coachella Stage".
Justin Bieber’s headlining performance at the 2026 Coachella festival marks his return to the stage as a headliner.
